name: Stream Probe
description: Plays each channel for a few seconds through Dispatcharr's own proxy, one at a time, and records resolution, codec, frame rate and bitrate on the stream that served it. Connection limits are respected, so a busy account is skipped, never kicked. Report-only.
author: funkasaur

fields.label: Probe user (Dispatcharr username)
fields.help_text: A dedicated non-admin user, so its traffic shows separately in usage counts.

fields.label: Only these channel groups (comma-separated, exact names)
fields.help_text: Empty = every group except the excluded ones.

fields.label: Skip these channel groups (comma-separated, exact names)
fields.help_text: Event-slot groups are empty most of the day; probing them says nothing.

fields.label: Re-check a working channel after (days)
fields.help_text: Never-checked channels go first, then the oldest. Failed ones are retried on the next run.

fields.label: Give up on a channel after (seconds without video)
Leave this many provider connections free for viewers
fields.help_text: Before each channel the probe counts free connections on the provider login(s) behind its first stream's M3U account, including other M3U accounts that use the same login; at or below this number the channel is logged as busy and retried next run.

fields.label: Dispatcharr address seen from inside the container
fields.help_text: Where the probe opens /live/... URLs. The default fits the standard image (uWSGI on port 9191).

fields.label: Alerts
fields.description: After a scheduled run that finds newly dead channels, one summary goes to Telegram and/or email. Channels that were already dead on the previous check are counted, not listed again.

fields.label: Probe but never alert on these groups (comma-separated, exact names)
fields.help_text: For large optional groups where dead channels are expected. They still show in Report.

fields.label: Server label
fields.help_text: Name used in alerts. Empty = hostname.

actions.label: Probe now
actions.description: Start a run now in the background (uses the limits above; params: limit, group, channel_ids). Watch progress with Status.

actions.label: Stop
actions.description: Stop the running probe after the current channel.

actions.label: Report
actions.description: Dead/busy channels and the quality of everything probed.

actions.label: Dead list (JSON)
actions.description: Channels whose last check failed, with how many checks in a row failed, for scripts.

actions.label: Apply schedule
actions.description: Create, update or switch off the nightly run.

actions.label: Send test alert
actions.description: Send a test message to the configured Telegram chat and email.
